name: work-items
description: Repo-durable work items for humans and agents — the wi CLI over one-markdown-file-per-item stores (including a read-only cross-repo sweep with an on-demand review skill over it), and the work-source provider interface (soft dependencies: statusline-hub, whose sensor record gives the review its quota line; operator-interaction, whose decisions skill the review follows when it puts a decision to the operator).
